evidence.quoted_text:
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
evidence.reason: The current `atomic` implementation creates the temporary file with `delete=False`, records `temporary` only after `fsync`, and calls `os.replace` outside any `finally` cleanup. If `write`, `flush`, `fsync`, or `os.replace` raises, the staging file remains on disk, so repeated failures can leak files and consume space; this is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing atomic-write behavior, not a request to enlarge contract scope.
